fields.mechanism: Accurate and continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) parameter measurement using on-device computational methods.
fields.intervention: Implement on-device computational methods, such as FeatureDB, to compute PR, QT, and QTc intervals from single-lead signals in the health monitoring device.
fields.expected_effect: High concordance with annotations, with mean absolute errors (MAEs) comparable to inter-observer variability, and diagnostic performance comparable to commercial 12-lead systems.
fields.falsification_test: Compare the diagnostic performance of the implemented on-device computational methods to commercial 12-lead systems and an open-source algorithm using AUC, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity metrics.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "FeatureDB-derived parameters showed high concordance with annotations, with MAEs comparable to inter-observer variability and Pearson correlation coefficients."
